description: Keep Task evidence outside canonical product generations.
changelog: Task evidence under .pactile/evidence remains user data during generation discovery, build seeding, capture and materialization. Source archives, media and dependency links do not enter a generation. Managed canonical files retain full size, path and link safety checks. Manifest continuity is restored for 0.6.3.
notes: Prepared before beta acceptance so stable promotion changes only package version and release documentation. No project data transformation is introduced. Task evidence, migration snapshots, journals and user backups remain preserved.
